elements.name: Apply a ribbon customization during a modeling command

steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its solid block in the MCAD Software
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
the Part Tools custom panel target is initially empty
the user starts Shell from Modify
the user selects the Tools ribbon tab
the user opens the Options panel title context menu
the user selects Customize User Commands
the user adds 2D Sketches to the Part Tools target
the user clicks Apply
the customization dialog remains open
the target list retains 2D Sketches without a pending marker
the User Commands panel is visible behind the dialog
the Shell properties and model preview remain visible behind the dialog
the user removes 2D Sketches from the Part Tools target
the user clicks Apply
the Part Tools target is empty without a pending marker
the User Commands panel remains visible behind the dialog
the Shell properties and model preview remain visible behind the dialog
the user closes customization
the User Commands panel is removed
the Shell properties and model preview remain visible
the user cancels Shell
the command properties and preview close
the original solid block remains visible

elements.name: Apply a ribbon customization during a modeling command

steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory
